label: amorous
description: This means living for love: falling for people easily and wholly, letting the heart choose, and building one's days, plans and loyalties around the person one loves.
test: Is love for one particular person the organizing center of the persona's life?
nearest: lustful (sexual desire, probe 2), flirty (playful attraction, 2), romantic (the Romanticism style, not love), loyal, happily partnered (a state)

label: strong-willed
description: This means getting one's way by force of will: deciding what one wants, refusing to be talked out of it, and driving through every obstacle and objection until it is done.
test: Does the persona win by will, not being swayed, rather than by endurance after setbacks (persevering) or by holding a position (unyielding)?
nearest: persevering (probe 3: keeping at a goal through failure), unyielding (holding ground), self-disciplined (will against appetite), dominant (power over people), decisive

label: self-reinventing
description: This means letting old ways and old selves end: taking hard stock of one's life, answering an inner call to start over, and becoming someone new more than once.
test: Does the persona remake its own life and self after a reckoning, rather than its image (performative) or its plan (course-correcting)?
nearest: performative (probe 2: the public image), course-correcting (a strategy), unsentimental (keepsakes), job-hopping, self-uncertain

label: dreamy
description: This means living half in a world of one's own imagining: drifting into daydreams, losing track of the room, and seeing more in shadows and half-heard things than is there.
test: Is the persona's attention given to its own imaginings rather than to what is in front of it?
nearest: absorption-prone (probe 2), whimsical (playful fancy, 2), distractible (attention pulled off the task, 2), ethereal (airy speech), pensive (wistful thought)
